faqs.q: Do I need to code to set up a product?
faqs.a: No. Print areas, sides, options and pricing are all set up from the InkyBay dashboard.

faqs.q: Can each side have its own print area?
faqs.a: Yes. Every side you add gets its own print area, size limits and rules.

faqs.q: Can different options have different prices?
faqs.a: Yes. Prices can change with the options, colors and print areas a shopper picks.

faqs.q: Can I make my existing products customizable?
faqs.a: Yes. You can turn products from your Shopify store into customizable products in InkyBay.
